title: Campaign
description: Small campaign card served by GET /v1/campaigns and SSE /v1/campaigns/stream. A projection of an Incident of type campaign or kit_reuse, computed by the API; it carries defanged/aggregate data only.

brand_name.description: Display names from the brand registry (data/brands.yaml name_ar / name_en); a humanised brand_id if the brand is not in it; null when brand_id is null.

series.description: Indicator first-seen counts in 12 equal time buckets between the first and last indicator.

source.description: Replayed or synthetic data stays labelled.

found_before_report.description: Optional. The incident's detection.found_before_report (hunt mode found every domain before any person checked or reported it).

hunt_count.description: Optional. Number of linked domain indicators first found by the hunt mode.
